msg: there is two different height gnomes. I found that the taller, darker coloured ones gave more mushrooms on the x5 than the shorter/lighter colour gnomes did. I also felt that selecting the gnome on the left for the x1 multiplier gave a good amount of mushrooms. My favourite colours to pick were the browny reddish colour, along with purple and blue. It does seem random, so just try your best and good luck!
